allResEnabled.name: Apply Resistance to All Damage rule (errata)
allResEnabled.hint: If enabled, the module shows a damage-type selection dialog for targets with Resistance to All Damage. If disabled, the module only fixes weakness/resistance (once-per-effect), leaving all-res rules untouched.

autoApplyBest.name: Automatically select best resistance
autoApplyBest.hint: Don't show the selection dialog. The module will apply the resistance to the damage type that results in the lowest total damage.

showChatMessage.name: Show IWR breakdown in chat
showChatMessage.hint: Add an info icon with the applied resistances and weaknesses to the PF2e damage message.

errataIWR.name: Apply weakness/resistance once per effect (errata)
errataIWR.hint: If a target has a weakness or resistance with a condition (e.g. to area damage or to spells), it will trigger once per effect, not once per damage type. Matches Spring 2026 errata.

debugIWRType.name: Debug: show applied damage type
debugIWRType.hint: In the chat tooltip, append the damage type each resistance or weakness was applied to. Debug only.
